_about: P02 capture validation. 'packets': layouts corrected or first annotated from captures (they override earlier annotation files that sort before P02.json). 'evidence': opcodes whose existing annotation a capture confirmed field by field, without changing it (`packets.py` renders each entry as a **Captured** line in packets-<server>.md; capture-validation.md has the full reasoning). Capture names are re-data/captures/26_11_15_<name>.pcapng. Batch-2 aliases: 'shop' = 26_11_15_buy item, equip item, use storage, unequip, sell item, travel portal, attack, use soulstones; 'combat' = 26_11_15_travel portal, attack mob, pick-up item, die, revive, linkto.
